rollups.text: The user’s stated views on nuclear weapons, expressed May 29, 2023, emphasized deterrence and real-world international politics: the user argued that nuclear deterrence helped prevent major conflict and kept the Cold War from becoming hot, questioned whether a world without nuclear weapons would be safer, and cautioned against judging disarmament only by moral ideals. The user invoked Hobbes’s view of international politics, described weakening multilateralism and growing multipolarity, and warned that utopian proposals could threaten peace.
rollups.topic: views on nuclear deterrence and disarmament
